themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Meta launched about $35 billion of stock offerings on Oct 26 (about $22.5 billion of common and $12.5 billion of mandatory convertible preferred), the first part of a plan to raise up to $95 billion, with a $60 billion share program in early 2027; Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom indicated interest in buying up to $5 billion (CNBC, Bloomberg). The same weekend Musk said debt markets have almost shut for neoclouds, and CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN fell 3% to more than 4% premarket (CNBC).
themes.for_you: No action before Alphabet and Microsoft report Wednesday. META is Wait (642.62 on Oct 23) and is left out of both lists: the raise funds its build but dilutes holders. NVDA and AMD still wait for the chart; NBIS is 'Accumulate on pullback' but its lenders are the risk now.

innovations.name: Industrials
innovations.what: Tesla said on its Oct 21 call that early Optimus production has started on a Fremont line built for about 1 million robots a year, that reaching about 20,000 a week will take at least a year, and that it plans to sell to outside companies around the end of 2027, with its AI5 chip in Optimus around April 2027. Stage stays pilot: output is for internal use and there are no outside orders yet.
innovations.for_you: No action. TSLA is Avoid and no humanoid name is a setup. All three are left out of both lists: a production line is progress, but outside revenue is about a year away.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.what: Lula won the Oct 25 runoff 51.79% to 48.21% (TSE), against polls and betting markets that favored Flavio Bolsonaro, who says he will seek annulment. On Oct 26 the dollar opened up 8.65% at R$5.425, a circuit breaker halted the Ibovespa, and in New York premarket EWZ fell 25.3% to 31.83, NU 23.6% to 11.57, PBR 23.6% to 19.98 and ITUB 25.6% to 7.19 (Benzinga, InfoMoney).
countries.for_you: No Brazil buys or puts today. NU fell through its 14.13 to 15.02 zone instead of into it, so Sunday's 'wait for buyers to lead' rule holds and the verdict will likely change tonight. An EWZ put sold last week is in the money; with no verdict, do not roll.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Trump said on Oct 25 'There will not be a strike today' on Iran, and Saudi Arabia's defense minister, Pakistan's army chief and Turkey's intelligence chief met Iranian officials in Tehran on Oct 26 (AP). Brent fell about 2% to $114.50 in early trading (AGBI). Argus, citing a source, said Aramco's Yanbu and Shaybah sites were not damaged, while a gas tanker was reported attacked near Oman on Oct 25 (Gulf News).
countries.for_you: If you hold energy swings, keep the stops (XOM 162.99, CVX 210.45); a 2% oil dip does not threaten them, and both report Oct 30. No new energy swings or puts. SLB is left out of both lists: talks lower the risk to its Gulf work but also lower oil.
